summary: What runs is what was reviewed: skills, tools and model versions the subject may load are pinned by content hash, and the execution environment is isolated as declared.

partialOrder.rule: B is not wider than A when B.pinned is a subset of A.pinned, B.isolation is at least as strong (none < process-sandbox < container < vm < tee) and B.networkEgress is a subset of A.networkEgress.

verification.resultMeaning: every loaded artifact matched a pinned hash and egress stayed within the list
the environment image and its configuration match the pinned runtime image

limitations: Pinning says nothing about whether the pinned content is itself safe; that is a matter of review evidence attached separately.
